summary: Members of Council may file petitions.
decided: City Council on February 19, 2020, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "Save the Cabbagetown Youth Centre", submitted by Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam, Ward 13, Toronto Centre, containing the names of approximately 919 persons. 2. Petition headed "Fund the Regent Park Social Development Plan", submitted by Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam, Ward 13, Toronto Centre, containing the names of approximately 739 persons. 3. Petition headed "For Climate Emergency Funding in the 2020 Budget", submitted by Councillor Gord Perks, Ward 4, Parkdale-High Park, containing the names of approximately 76 persons. 4. Petition headed "For Climate Emergency Funding in the 2020 Budget", submitted by Councillor Paula Fletcher, Ward 14, Toronto-Danforth, containing the names of approximately 62 persons. 5. Petition headed "For Climate Emergency Funding in the 2020 Budget", submitted by Councillor Mike Layton, Ward 11, University-Rosedale, containing the names of approximately 96 persons. 6. Petition headed "For Climate Emergency Funding in the 2020 Budget", submitted by Councillor Josh Matlow, Ward 12, Toronto-St. Paul's, containing the names of approximately 100 persons. 7. Petition headed "For Climate Emergency Funding in the 2020 Budget", submitted by Councillor Brad Bradford, Ward 19, Beaches-East York, containing the names of approximately 6 persons.
